title: Stability of Change-of-Num\'eraire Reweighting: An Exact Wasserstein Boundary
abstract: arXiv:2609.30329v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reweighting a probability law by a positive num\'eraire and pushing forward the payoff-to-num\'eraire ratio yields the change-of-num\'eraire reweighting: the swap-rate law under the annuity measure, the num\'eraire-inversion involution of martingale optimal transport, and the population form of self-normalized importance sampling. We characterize exactly when it is Wasserstein-stable. Along weakly convergent inputs with uniformly integrable num\'eraires and a strictly positive limiting num\'eraire mean, convergence of the reweighted laws is equivalent to a uniform integrability condition, computed under the inputs, on one explicit family in the payoff and num\'eraire. At first order the num\'eraire cancels, the sole obstruction being payoff mass where the num\'eraire vanishes; absent such mass, prices and first moments pass to the limit under a uniformly integrable payoff alone, with no assumption on the reciprocal num\'eraire. Two-ato

translated_title: 计价物变换重加权的稳定性：一个精确的Wasserstein边界
translated_abstract: 通过一个正的计价物对概率分布进行重加权，并对“收益除以计价物”之比作前推映射，即得到计价物变换重加权：它涵盖了年金测度下的互换利率分布、鞅最优传输中的计价物反演对合，以及自归一化重要性抽样的总体形式。我们精确刻画了该操作何时具有Wasserstein稳定性。对于弱收敛的输入序列，在计价物一致可积且极限计价物均值严格为正的条件下，重加权后分布的收敛等价于一个一致可积性条件，该条件在输入分布下计算，针对由收益与计价物构成的一个显式函数族。在一阶层面，计价物相互抵消，唯一的障碍是落在计价物零点处的收益质量；若不存在此类质量，则仅需假设收益一致可积，价格与一阶矩便可收敛到极限，而无需对倒数计价物作任何假设。
tldr: 本文精确刻画了计价物变换重加权的Wasserstein稳定性：重加权分布的收敛等价于一个关于收益与计价物显式函数族的一致可积性条件，且当计价物零点处不存在收益质量时，仅需收益一致可积即可保证价格与一阶矩收敛到极限。
en_tdlr: This paper exactly characterizes the Wasserstein stability of change-of-numéraire reweighting: convergence of the reweighted laws is equivalent to a uniform integrability condition on an explicit family of the payoff and numéraire, and prices and first moments pass to the limit whenever no payoff mass sits where the numéraire vanishes.
